photos.desc: The violet sabrewing and green hermit hummingbirds are large by hummingbird standards, making them good candidates to wear tiny radio transmitters. (Photo: Matthew Betts)
Taxidermied violet sabrewing (Campylopterus hemileucurus) at the Natural History Museum in London, England.
Campylopterus hemileucurus, Puntarenas Province, Monteverde, Costa Rica, 2024-02-21 (iNaturalist).
